# Build Handoff: CHG-05 Participant Classroom
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

## Result

The approved participant extension is implemented locally. Participants can open a separate Classroom recordings page at `/classroom`; the page lists published sessions only. Administrators continue to use `/admin/classroom`, which lists published and draft sessions.

The implementation is not staging-verified or launch-accepted. Manual browser, light/dark, responsive, and final acceptance evidence remain open.

## Security And Scope

- The participant route is inside the authenticated and active-user middleware group.
- Participant listings filter `is_published = true` on the server.
- The existing session controller returns not found for unpublished sessions requested by participants.
- The admin route and draft-session visibility remain unchanged.
- No credentials, private keys, tokens, or real participant data were added.
